answer: Duplicate identities are rejected at minting, so a sybil farm must acquire and lock fresh pearls per fake agent, with each attempt costing real stake plus slashing risk. Each agent must stake a scarce on-chain credential, a pearl minted once from a verified oasis node, before voting. Honest agents keep their pearl across epochs, while attackers bleed capital on a shifting dune of expiring credentials. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
